summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 4,765,108 treasury shares (0.16% of share capital) on Euronext Milan from 22 to 26 June 2026 at a weighted average price of €20.9859 per share, for total consideration of €99,999,965. This is part of a buyback program approved on 6 May 2026 to provide additional remuneration to shareholders beyond dividends. Since 8 May 2026, Eni has acquired 24,793,590 shares (0.82% of share capital) for €559,916,415.61. The company now holds 111,621,697 shares (3.69% of share capital). The filing is a routine buyback update; watch for continued execution pace and any acceleration or conclusion of the remaining authorized program.
